mutations.name: an unknown template field renders as empty instead of failing
mutations.comment: Struct field lookups fail regardless of missingkey, so this is expected to SURVIVE against a struct payload; it is here to record that the option is not load-bearing today and would become so if the payload ever became a map.

mutations.comment: The dangerous shape: a refused edit still writes a reviewable-looking plan file. Must be killed by the no-plan-file assertion, not only by the message.
